translations.web: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
translations.bsb: For the levy of the prostitute is poverty, and the adulteress preys upon your very life.
translations.kjv: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
translations.asv: For on account of a harlot a man is brought to a piece of bread; And the adulteress hunteth for the precious life.
